image_description: A stocky, dark-furred wombat is crouched on a rocky surface near a cave entrance or overhang. The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body, short limbs, and a blunt head with small ears. The fur appears coarse and dark brown/grey. There are some scattered debris or droppings (possibly the characteristic cube-shaped feces) in the foreground.
